## Naming, applied to calendar

- Id dots become spaces: `calendar.events.list` → `grr calendar events list`. Resource segments and method names keep their exact Discovery casing (`otherContacts`, `getProfile`).
- Flags are the same ids, camelCase → kebab-case: `userId` → `--user-id`, `maxResults` → `--max-results`. Integers parse as numbers, booleans are presence flags, repeated parameters repeat, enum parameters validate.
- No parameter in this service collides with the reserved flag names (`params`, `body-file`, `query`, `dry-run`, `format`).
- Request bodies are untyped by design: `--params '<json>'` or `--body-file PATH|-`. Typed flags win on conflict.

## Examples

```sh
grr calendar events list --calendar-id <calendar-id> --max-attendees 10
grr calendar events get --calendar-id <calendar-id> --event-id <event-id>
grr calendar events insert --calendar-id <calendar-id> --dry-run
```

Values in `<angle brackets>` are placeholders — substitute real ids (`me` is the authenticated user wherever the parameter is `--user-id`). Append `--dry-run` to any example to print the resolved request — verb, URL, scopes — instead of sending it.

## Scopes

- Least privilege for reads: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.readonly` — the narrowest scope the service's methods accept (it is the least-privilege scope for 11 of 38 methods). Per method, ask the index: `grr api describe <id>` → `leastPrivilegeScope`.
- Scope honesty: grr consents to a fixed scope set at login. A method whose least-privilege scope falls outside that set prints a **note on stderr** and is attempted anyway; Google may answer 403, and the error names the exact scope. That is a user decision — widening scopes means a human re-runs `grr auth login`. Surface the note to the user; do not retry.

## Contract

- stdout is data, stderr is logs; JSON by default, `-f jsonl|table|pretty` to switch.
- `--dry-run` before anything destructive — the resolved request as JSON, nothing sent.
- Non-zero exit on failure; errors are actionable (a 403 names the missing scope, a typo gets ranked suggestions).
